decision.explanation: The question asks when the Swedish Evangelical Lutheran Church was built. Multiple documents refer to different instances of the Swedish Evangelical Lutheran Church in various locations (Ham Lake, Minnesota; Millville, Minnesota; Swedesburg, Iowa), each with their own construction dates. Document D1S3 states that the church in Ham Lake, Minnesota, was built in 1872. Document D4S2 and D6S1 mention the church in Millville, Minnesota, was built in 1874. Document D3S4 refers to a church in Walnut Grove, Minnesota, built in 1890. Document D7S3 describes the current church in Swedesburg, Iowa, built in 1928. Since these are distinct churches with the same name, all four dates are valid and should be included.
